creativeDirection: Book-themed design system — scrolling feels like slowly flipping book pages, with partially visible page curls, letterpress materiality, and generous whitespace

themes.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Light register (pageBackground #fdfdfd, luminance 253).
Line height loosening 1.25x for bookish generous leading. Cormorant Garamond headings, Open Sans body. All fonts Google Fonts CDN.
Duration scaling x2.5 with paper-drift easing cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.85, 0.25, 1.0). Languid page-turning feel.
Container max-width tightened from 1306px to 960px for book-page proportions. Padding doubled to 48px.
Section breathing room +48px for chapter-like spacing. Sections at 112px padding/margin.
Languid hover transitions at 0.55s with page-settling easing cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1.0).
Letter spacing increased from 0.08em to 0.14em for table-of-contents feel.
Material shift emphasizing book physicality — letterpress, uncoated stock, foil-stamped titling. Video concept: page-flip transitions, vellum-filtered hero, letterpress macro.
